INVALID_PUBLIC_KEY: This is not a valid ed25519 public key. Paste the public key printed by lode-cli keygen.
KEY_EXISTS: This key is already registered or was revoked. A revoked key cannot be registered again; generate a new one.
PACKAGE_EXISTS: You already have a package with this slug. Choose a different slug.
PACKAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: You have reached your package limit. Delete a package you no longer need or ask an administrator to raise the limit.
STORAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Your storage quota is full. Delete old versions or ask an administrator to raise the quota.
ASSET_TOO_LARGE: This file is larger than the asset size limit. Upload a smaller file or ask an administrator to raise the limit.
INVALID_GRANT: One of the selected packages does not exist or is not yours. Review the package list and try again.
VERSION_EXISTS: This version already exists. Use a different version number.
VERSION_RETIRED: A version with this number was published and then deleted. Use a different version number.
VERSION_NOT_DRAFT: This version is no longer a draft and cannot be changed. Create a new version instead.
VERSION_EMPTY: This version has no assets. Upload at least one asset before publishing.
VERSION_NOT_PUBLISHED: A channel can only point at a published version. Publish the version first.
VERSION_NOT_YANKED: This version is not yanked, so there is nothing to restore. Refresh the page to see its current state.
VERSION_IN_CHANNEL: A channel still points at this version. Move the channel first.
VERSION_BUSY: Another operation is in progress on this version. Wait a moment and try again.
NAMESPACE_SUSPENDED: This namespace is suspended and read-only. Contact an administrator to restore it.
SIGNATURE_REQUIRED: This package only accepts signed assets. Sign the file with lode-cli sign and upload it with its signature.
INVALID_SIGNATURE: The signature does not verify under any of your active signing keys. Check that the key is registered and not revoked, then sign again.
